before.en:
Claude-Michel Schönberg composed the music and co-wrote the book with Alain Boublil. The original French text is credited to Boublil and Jean-Marc Natel; Herbert Kretzmer wrote the English lyrics, with additional material credited to James Fenton.

In a 2015 interview for PRS for Music, Kretzmer described beginning with a song’s theme and creating its English wording afresh. The expanded show also needed words for new numbers, including Stars and Bring Him Home. Growing from roughly two hours in French to three in English meant adding dramatic material as well as reshaping existing songs. His exacting ear remained restless long afterward: he still thought one rhyme in On My Own too familiar, despite its fit with the thought he wanted to express.
